API Reference

Integrate seamlessly with the AIVerse Hub platform. Use our RESTful endpoints to check your balance, monitor live product stock, and automate your purchases in real-time.

Authentication

Every API request requires your unique API Key to be passed via the X-API-Key HTTP header.

X-API-Key: AK_YOUR_SECRET_KEY

Keep your API Key secret. If compromised, revoke it immediately via the Telegram Bot.

Rate Limits

To ensure platform stability, all API endpoints are rate-limited to 3 requests per second per API Key.

If you exceed this limit, the API will respond with HTTP status 429 Too Many Requests.

Code Examples

Use the snippets below to easily integrate the automated ordering endpoint into your application.

curl -X POST https://aiversehub.store/api/v1/order ^
  -H "X-API-Key: AK_YOUR_SECRET_KEY" ^
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" ^
  -d "{\"service_id\": \"S_01\", \"quantity\": 1}"
import requests

url = "https://aiversehub.store/api/v1/order"
headers = {
    "X-API-Key": "AK_YOUR_SECRET_KEY"
}
payload = {
    "service_id": "S_01",
    "quantity": 1
}

response = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
const axios = require('axios');

axios.post('https://aiversehub.store/api/v1/order', {
  service_id: 'S_01',
  quantity: 1
}, {
  headers: { 'X-API-Key': 'AK_YOUR_SECRET_KEY' }
})
.then(response => console.log(response.data))
.catch(error => console.error(error.response.data));
<?php
$ch = curl_init('https://aiversehub.store/api/v1/order');
$payload = json_encode(['service_id' => 'S_01', 'quantity' => 1]);

curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, $payload);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
    'Content-Type: application/json',
    'X-API-Key: AK_YOUR_SECRET_KEY'
]);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);

$result = curl_exec($ch);
curl_close($ch);
echo $result;
?>
GET

/api/v1/me

Fetch your profile information and real-time wallet balance.

Example Response

200 OK
{
  "chat_id": 123456789,
  "first_name": "John Doe",
  "wallet_balance": 150.50
}
GET

/api/v1/products

List all available products on the platform, along with their pricing and exact stock amounts.

Example Response

200 OK
{
  "services": [
    {
      "service_id": "S_01",
      "name": "Gemini Pro 1 Month",
      "price": 10.0,
      "stock": 42
    }
  ]
}
POST

/api/v1/order

Place an automated order. Costs are deducted from your balance and product codes are returned instantly.

Note on Stock: Depending on admin settings, the API may require a minimum stock buffer (e.g. 100 stock). If the buffer is active, API purchases can only be made from the stock available above the buffer limit.

Request Payload

application/json
{
  "service_id": "S_01",
  "quantity": 1
}

Success Response

200 OK
{
  "success": true,
  "order_id": "API_ABC123XYZ",
  "service_id": "S_01",
  "quantity": 1,
  "total_cost": 10.0,
  "new_balance": 140.50,
  "products": [
    "CODE_12345"
  ]
}

Error Response

400 Bad Request
{
  "error": "Insufficient balance"
}
GET

/api/v1/orders

Fetch your complete order history. Supports optional page and limit parameters (default is 50).
Note: The maximum limit allowed is 200. Entering a value greater than 200 will return an error.

Example Request

GET /api/v1/orders?page=1&limit=50

Example Response

200 OK
{
  "success": true,
  "page": 1,
  "limit": 50,
  "total_orders": 120,
  "total_pages": 3,
  "orders": [
    {
      "order_id": "TRXN12345",
      "service": "Gemini Pro",
      "quantity": 1,
      "amount": 10.0,
      "status": "success",
      "delivered_products": ["CODE_XYZ"],
      "created_at": "2026-07-09T08:00:00"
    }
  ]
}
GET

/api/v1/order/{id}

Fetch details of a specific order using its order_id.

Example Response

200 OK
{
  "success": true,
  "order": {
    "order_id": "TRXN12345",
    "service": "Gemini Pro",
    "quantity": 1,
    "amount": 10.0,
    "status": "success",
    "delivered_products": ["CODE_XYZ"]
  }
}
GET

/api/v1/stats

Fetch comprehensive statistics for your account, including total deposits, total spends, and a per-product breakdown of your purchases. Supports optional custom date filtering.

Query Parameters (Optional)

  • start - Custom start date (Format: YYYY-MM-DD-HH:MM-AM/PM e.g. 2026-07-09-10:00-AM)
  • end - Custom end date (Format: YYYY-MM-DD-HH:MM-AM/PM)

Example Response

200 OK
{
  "success": true,
  "deposits": {
    "today": 10.0,
    "7d": 50.0,
    "30d": 200.0,
    "365d": 1500.0,
    "all_time": 2000.0
  },
  "sales": {
    "today": 5.0,
    "7d": 30.0,
    "30d": 150.0,
    "365d": 1200.0,
    "all_time": 1800.0
  },
  "products_breakdown": [
    {
      "service_id": "service_123",
      "name": "Premium Product",
      "quantity_sold": 10,
      "revenue": 100.0
    }
  ]
}
